goal: Allow valid Taproot signatures to finalize when the optional sighash type field is omitted
Prevents unexpected finalization failures when coordinating with external signers
agreement: Discussion centers on which sighash types should be permitted without an explicit field
Unaddressed objection: absent sighash field should accept only ALL and DEFAULT signatures (fametrano)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it fixes PSBT finalization failures for valid Taproot spends from external signers
Users currently face rejected transactions when signatures self-describe their sighash type
